sourceChecks.text: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でこの人物/集団が明示され、該当する用例として採用。
